title: Bulguksa Temple
summary: Bulguksa is a Buddhist temple complex on Mount Tohamsan near Gyeongju, capital of Silla, established in the 8th century. Prime Minister Kim Dae-seong initiated and supervised its construction in memory of his parents. Its wooden halls stand on stone terraces, with the pagodas Seokgatap and Dabotap before the main hall. One encyclopedia gives a traditional start of 751 and completion in 790. UNESCO inscribed it with Seokguram Grotto in 1995.

uncertainty.note: UNESCO says only 'established in the 8th century'; the 751 start and 790 finish are the traditional dates quoted by World History Encyclopedia.

importance.justification: UNESCO regards the temple with Seokguram as an outstanding example of Buddhist religious architecture of Silla Gyeongju and the grotto as a masterpiece of East Asian Buddhist art.
